concerns.text: The plan does not specify an explicit Single Source of Truth (SSoT) artifact (e.g., a designated SSoT file or manifest). Principle IV of the constitution requires a clear SSoT designation so that every figure, statistic, or interpretation can be traced back to a unique data row and code block.

Reproducibility (Principle I) mandates that random seeds be pinned. The plan mentions "deterministic seeds" in the Constitution Check but does not list where or how seeds are set in the code or configuration, leaving a gap in reproducibility compliance.
